item.body:

And Copilot keep repeating itself ! While I had Copilot tab open the Editor and my computer itself were laggy and hard to use. I'm not sure if it is important or not, but my GitHub Copilot version is 1.290.1455. Windows, VSCode and extensions, all up to date. One of the problems of this behavior (beyond the bug itself) is that it may burn all my quota for Copilot =/
